# 03 — Minimal Viable Host: Capability-Guard Map & Incremental Stub-Host Build Order

## 0. Method & count reconciliation

Counts are mine, verified on this box against `/home/wbterminal/ac-refs/rynthsuite/Plugins/RynthCore.Plugin.RynthAi/` and the host capability list in `/home/wbterminal/ac-refs/rynthcore/src/RynthCore.PluginSdk/RynthCoreHost.cs`.

| Metric | Count | How derived |
|---|---|---|
| Raw `\bHas[A-Z]` tokens in plugin (`*.cs`) | 479 | `rg -o '\bHas[A-Z]...'` |
| — of which **real host-capability guards** | **367** | token ∈ host `public bool Has*` set (104 caps) |
| — internal computed booleans (NOT host guards) | 112 | `HasTargets` 11, `HasMore` 25, `HasEngageableTarget` 9, `HasWieldedAmmo` 8, `HasCloseThreat` 5, `HasFired` 7, `HasBounds` 6, … |
| Distinct host caps **defined** (`RynthCoreHost.cs`) | 104 | `rg 'public bool Has'` |
| Distinct host caps **guard-referenced** by plugin | 82 | matched set |
| Host caps **never guarded** (assumed-present / dead) | 22 | `comm -23` |

The brief's "~344" is an under-count; the true guard-site number is **367** (`Combat/CombatManager.cs:610`, `Combat/BuffManager.cs:1320`, etc. are representative). Per-file distribution:

| File | guard sites | File | guard sites |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Meta/ExpressionEngine.cs` | 101 | `Combat/BuffManager.cs` | 15 |
| `RynthAiPlugin.cs` | 37 | `Meta/MetaManager.cs` | 14 |
| `RynthAiCommands.cs` | 33 | `Combat/WorldObjectCache.cs` | 14 |
| `Combat/CombatManager.cs` | 26 | `Loot/SalvageManager.cs` | 4 |
| `NavigationEngine.cs` | 20 | `Loot/VTankLootEvaluator.cs` | 4 |
| `CorpseOpenController.cs` | 20 | `Combat/SpellManager.cs` | 2 |
| `MagToolsCommands.cs` | 15 | 17 UI/misc files | 1–9 each |

**Critical structural finding (drives the whole build plan):** the ABI has **two planes**, and `Has*` guards cover only one.

1. **Poll plane** — `TryGet*` reads + fire-and-forget actions, each gated (or not) by a `Has*` capability probe. Every host action method **self-no-ops when its fn pointer is null** (`RynthCoreHost.cs:197` `return _api.MeleeAttackFn != IntPtr.Zero && …`; same pattern lines 207–223). So an unguarded call is *safe* but *silently does nothing* without the fn.
2. **Event-push plane** — the host pushes world state into `public override void On*` methods (`RynthAiPlugin.cs:1496 OnCreateObject`, `1505 OnDeleteObject`, `1519 OnUpdateHealth`, `1933 OnEnchantmentAdded`, `1938 OnEnchantmentRemoved`, `1471 OnChatWindowText`, `1489 OnKillNotification`, `1435 OnSelectedTargetChange`, `1464 OnCombatModeChange`, `874 OnTick`, `253 OnLoginComplete`). **There is no `Has*` guard for events** — the entire object model (`WorldObjectCache`) is built from `OnCreateObject`/`OnDeleteObject` (`WorldObjectCache.cs:154`), and `_objectCache.GetContainedItems` (`CorpseOpenController.cs:877`) reads corpse loot straight out of that event-fed cache.

Consequence: **a minimal host must implement a matched *pair* — the guarded poll caps AND the un-guarded event feeds — or the loop compiles-and-runs-but-idles.** The 22 never-guarded caps are the trap: `HasMeleeAttack`, `HasMissileAttack`, `HasSetAutoRun`, `HasSetSelectedObjectId` are **defined but never checked** — the plugin calls `_host.MeleeAttack`/`_host.SetAutoRun`/`_host.SelectItem` unconditionally (`CombatManager.cs:2843`, `NavigationEngine.cs:575`, `CombatManager.cs:2834`). A naive "implement only what's `Has`-guarded" strategy would omit the three most important attack/move primitives.

### Guard-semantics taxonomy (used in every table below)

| Mark | Meaning | Detection pattern |
|---|---|---|
| **R** | **Required** — loop's core action is impossible without it | (a) guard with early-return that aborts the action, or (b) **called un-guarded** (implicitly assumed; host no-ops → loop idles) |
| **G** | **Graceful** — guarded; absence disables an enhancement or falls back | `Has ? Get() : default` / `if(!Has) return -1;` in a non-core helper |
| **E** | **Event feed** (no `Has*` exists) — must be pushed or the world model is empty | `On*` override |

## (a) Subsystem × host-capability requirement matrix

Only the six subsystems that matter for the four target loops (plus the shared world model). `ExpressionEngine`/`MetaManager` (115 of the 367 guard sites) are the **user-scripting layer** — needed for VTank-style meta routes, **not** for any of the four loops — so they are excluded from the minimal host.

### Read / poll capabilities

| Host cap (guard) | Combat­Manager | Buff­Manager | Navigation­Engine | Corpse/Loot | World­ObjectCache | Evidence (file:line) |
|---|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|---|
| `HasGetPlayerId` / `GetPlayerId()` | **R** | **R** | **R** | **R** | R | `CombatManager.cs:1831`, `BuffManager.cs:771`, `WorldObjectCache.cs:980` |
| `HasGetObjectPosition` / `TryGetObjectPosition` | **R** | – | **R** | **R** | **R** | `WorldObjectCache.cs:892-894` (`Distance` backbone), `CombatManager.cs:2628`, `NavigationEngine.cs:1357` |

| `HasGetCurrentCombatMode` | G | G | – | – | – | `CombatManager.cs:184`, `BuffManager.cs:230` (`Has ? Get : NonCombat`) |

\* `HasObjectIsAttackable` guard is a *veto filter* (`if (Has && !attackable) continue`, `CombatManager.cs:610`): absent → filter skipped → the bot will happily target NPCs/players. Functionally "graceful" but **behaviorally required** for a safe loop.

## (b) Smallest host subset per target loop

Legend: **●** irreducible (loop cannot act) · ○ needed for correct/safe behavior · ◦ optional polish.

### Loop 1 — Melee combat

| # | Host surface | Tier | Why |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| ● | `OnCreateObject` / `OnDeleteObject` (event) | E | build the target list; no world model = nothing to fight |
| ● | `OnTick` (event) | E | drives `CombatManager.OnHeartbeat` (`RynthAiPlugin.cs:1327`) |
| ● | `GetPlayerId` | R | distance anchor (`CombatManager.cs:1831`) |
| ● | `GetObjectPosition` | R | `Distance()` ring-scan + disengage gate (`WorldObjectCache.cs:892`) |
| ● | `MeleeAttack(id,height,power)` | R | the swing (`CombatManager.cs:2843`) |
| ● | `ChangeCombatMode(Melee)` | R | `EquipWeaponAndSetStance` (`:2034`) — AC refuses attack in Peace |
| ○ | `ObjectIsAttackable` | R* | do-not-hit-NPCs veto (`:610,2897`) |
| ○ | `OnUpdateHealth` + `OnKillNotification` | E | detect the mob died → drop target |
| ○ | `GetBusyState` | G | command pacing; else degrades to `-1` (spams) |
| ◦ | `GetObjectWcid`, `GetObjectName` | G | per-monster weapon rules; else fights with default/unarmed |

**Irreducible melee host = 4 fns + 2 actions + 3 events (`GetPlayerId`, `GetObjectPosition`, `MeleeAttack`, `ChangeCombatMode`; `OnCreateObject/OnDeleteObject/OnTick`).** No target selection, no health poll, no busy state strictly required to swing.

### Loop 2 — Self-buffing

| # | Host surface | Tier | Why |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| ● | `OnTick` | E | drives the buff arbiter (`RynthAiPlugin.cs:1101-1152`) |
| ● | `GetPlayerId` | R | cast target = self (`BuffManager.cs:771`) |
| ● | `CastSpell(self, spellId)` | R | the buff cast (`:928`) |
| ○ | `ChangeCombatMode(Magic)` + `UseObject(wand)` | R | only if the char casts from a wand (`:2064,2118`); a no-focus caster can skip |
| ○ | `OnEnchantmentAdded` / `OnEnchantmentRemoved` | E | populate `_ramBuffTimers` → stop re-casting live buffs; **without either these or `ReadPlayerEnchantments`+`GetServerTime`, it buffs blindly (still functional)** |
| ◦ | `OnChatWindowText` | G | "You cast X" confirm / no-chat → tier-down (`SpellManager` `_unresolvableSpellIds`) |
| ◦ | `ReadKnownSpells`/`IsSpellKnown` | G | not needed — spell ids resolve from static `SpellDictionary` (`SpellManager.cs:27-29`) |

**Irreducible buff host = `GetPlayerId` + `CastSpell` + `OnTick`** (add wand `UseObject`+`ChangeCombatMode` for wand casters; add enchant events to avoid blind re-casts).

### Loop 3 — Loot + pickup

| # | Host surface | Tier | Why |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| ● | `OnCreateObject` / `OnDeleteObject` | E | corpse + its contents arrive in the create-burst (`CorpseOpenController.cs:877-887`); delete = pickup confirm |
| ● | `OnTick` | E | drives `TickCorpseOpening` (`RynthAiPlugin.cs:1329`) |
| ● | `GetPlayerId` + `GetObjectPosition` | R | nearest-corpse distance / approach |
| ● | `UseObject(corpseId)` | R | open the corpse (`:1698`) |
| ● | `GetGroundContainerId` | R | id of the just-opened container — hard `return` if absent (`:1704`) |
| ● | `GetObjectOwnershipInfo` (or `GetContainerContents`) | R | which items belong to the corpse (`GetContainerId→GetContainedItems`, `WorldObjectCache.cs:861,1136`) |
| ● | `UseObject(itemId)` **or** `MoveItemExternal(item,player,0)` | R | the pickup (`:1078` fallback / `:1074` preferred) |
| ○ | `GetObjectName` | R | item identity for name rules (`WorldObjectCache.cs:1459`) |
| ○ | `SelectItem` | R | precedes the move/use (`:1057,1157`) |
| ◦ | `RequestId`+`HasAppraisalData`, `GetItemType`, `GetObjectIntProperty` | G | stat-based VTank rules; else class/name rules only (`:932,1440`) |

**Irreducible loot host = `GetPlayerId`, `GetObjectPosition`, `UseObject`, `GetGroundContainerId`, `GetObjectOwnershipInfo` + create/delete/tick events.** `MoveItemExternal` and appraisal are optional (pickup can ride `UseObject`; rules can be name-only).

### Loop 4 — Follow / approach movement

| # | Host surface | Tier | Why |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| ● | `OnCreateObject`/`OnDeleteObject` + `OnTick` | E | know the follow target exists + drive `NavigationEngine.Tick` (`RynthAiPlugin.cs:1391`) |
| ● | `GetPlayerId` + `GetObjectPosition` | R | self + target position → bearing/`Distance` |
| ● | `SetAutoRun(bool)` | R | **the only forward-locomotion primitive** (un-guarded; `NavigationEngine.cs:575,664`) |
| ● | `TurnToHeading(deg)` | R | face the target — turn aborts if this **and** Tier-1 are absent (`:503`) |
| ○ | `GetPlayerPose`/`GetPlayerHeading` | R | current heading to compute turn error (`:1418`); without it turns are open-loop |
| ◦ | `StopCompletely` | G | clean arrival stop (`:253,1312`) |
| ◦ | `GetBusyState`, `IsPortaling` | G | pacing / portal-transit suppression |

**Irreducible follow host = `GetPlayerId`, `GetObjectPosition`, `GetPlayerHeading`, `SetAutoRun`, `TurnToHeading` + events.** Note: *following a **fellowship leader*** needs the leader's object id, which today comes from `FellowshipTracker` — an **unportable island** (hardcoded acclient memory addresses). The follow *mechanics* (steer to any object id's live position) are fully portable; only the leader-id source must be re-sourced from a holtburger web signal.

### Union — the four loops share a 4-item spine

`OnCreateObject`, `OnDeleteObject`, `OnTick`, `GetPlayerId` + `GetObjectPosition` underpin all four. Build these first and every loop lights up incrementally on top.

## (c) Ranked incremental stub-host implementation order

Order = dependency topology × behavioral payoff. Each tier is independently demoable against holtburger-web.

### Tier 0 — World-model spine (implement these **8** first)

| # | Surface | Plane | Justification |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `OnTick()` pump | event | Nothing runs without the synchronous heartbeat (`RynthAiPlugin.cs:874`). **This is the deepest port risk** — the browser is async (rAF / message-drain); the host must synthesize a poll-style tick (e.g. drive from `?netDrainHz=N` drain, `nullRender=1`). |
| 2 | `OnCreateObject(id)` | event | Seeds `WorldObjectCache` (`:154`). Map from holtburger `entityMap` add. |
| 3 | `OnDeleteObject(id)` | event | Despawn / pickup / death. Map from `entityMap` remove. |
| 4 | `GetPlayerId()` | poll R | Distance anchor for **all four** loops. `window.__sessionHandle` player guid. |
| 5 | `GetObjectPosition(id)`→(cell,x,y,z) | poll R | `Distance()` backbone (`WorldObjectCache.cs:892`). Landblock-packed cell (`(cell>>24)*192+x`). Must expose from `SessionHandle`/`entityMap` positions. |
| 6 | `GetObjectName(id)` | poll R | Object identity (targets, loot). |
| 7 | `GetObjectWcid(id)` | poll G→R | Object type; used by combat rules, loot, classify. |
| 8 | `OnLoginComplete()` | event | Bootstrap gate (`:253`); managers init here. |

Deliverable at end of Tier 0: the plugin has a live, queryable world model and a heartbeat — **no actions yet**, but `entityMap`-equivalent parity is provable.

### Tier 1 — Melee combat (next **6**: caps 9–14)

| # | Surface | Plane | Justification |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | `MeleeAttack(id,height,power)` | action R | The swing. **Never `Has`-guarded** — do not skip. |
| 10 | `ChangeCombatMode(mode)` | action R | AC won't attack in Peace mode. |
| 11 | `ObjectIsAttackable(id)` | poll R* | Target-safety veto (`:610`). |
| 12 | `OnUpdateHealth(id,ratio,cur,max)` | event | Death detection → drop target. |
| 13 | `GetBusyState()` | poll G | Command pacing; else `-1` spams. |
| 14 | `OnKillNotification` / `GetCurrentCombatMode` | event/poll | Kill confirm + stance read. |

Justification for ordering combat before movement (despite the task numbering it #1 vs #4): melee only needs the world spine + these 6; it can be demoed by teleporting the bot onto a mob (as `k1_drive_combat.cjs` already does — logs in, teleports, toggles combat, attacks). Movement (Tier 3) is a larger surface and can follow.

### Tier 2 — Self-buffing (next **4**: caps 15–18)

| # | Surface | Plane | Justification |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 | `CastSpell(self, spellId)` | action R | The buff. |
| 16 | `UseObject(id)` | action R | Wand equip (also unlocks Tier-4 corpse-open + pickup — high reuse). |
| 17 | `OnEnchantmentAdded(spell,dur)` | event | Buff timers → stop blind re-casting. |
| 18 | `OnEnchantmentRemoved(id)` | event | Buff expiry. |

`ChangeCombatMode` (from Tier 1) is reused for wand→Magic. Spell-id resolution rides the static `SpellDictionary`, so **no `ReadKnownSpells`/`IsSpellKnown` needed**. This is the cheapest full loop — 2 new actions + 2 events.

### Tier 3 — Follow / approach movement (next **5**: caps 19–23)

| # | Surface | Plane | Justification |
|---|---|---|---|
| 19 | `SetAutoRun(bool)` | action R | Forward locomotion — un-guarded, singular. |
| 20 | `TurnToHeading(deg)` | action R | Facing; turn aborts without it (`:503`). |
| 21 | `GetPlayerHeading`/`GetPlayerPose` | poll R | Closed-loop turn error (`:1418`). |
| 22 | `StopCompletely` | action G | Arrival stop / hand-off between controllers. |
| 23 | `IsPortaling` / `GetCurCoords` | poll G | Portal-transit suppression / teleport detect. |

Deferred deliberately: `DoMovement`/`StopMovement` (Tier-1 turn mode) — an *alternative* to `TurnToHeading`, not additive; pick one actuator. On holtburger-web, `TurnToHeading` maps cleanly to a heading setter and is the simpler choice.

### Tier 4 — Loot + pickup (next **6**: caps 24–29)

| # | Surface | Plane | Justification |
|---|---|---|---|
| 24 | `GetGroundContainerId()` | poll R | Hard `return` without it (`:1704`). |
| 25 | `GetObjectOwnershipInfo(id)` | poll R | Corpse-contents membership (`GetContainerId`, `:861`). |
| 26 | `SelectItem(id)` | action R | Precedes move/use (`:1057`). |
| 27 | `MoveItemExternal(item,player,slot)` | action G | Preferred pickup (`:1074`); else `UseObject` fallback. |
| 28 | `RequestId(id)` + `HasAppraisalData(id)` | poll G | Stat-based loot rules. |
| 29 | `GetItemType` + `GetObjectIntProperty` | poll G | VTank rule evaluation (`VTankLootEvaluator`). |

`UseObject` (Tier 2) already opens the corpse and is the pickup fallback, so loot rides mostly on reads. Appraisal (28–29) is optional for a name/class-only rule set.

### Explicitly out of scope for the minimal host (do NOT implement for the 4 loops)

| Surface | Guard sites | Why deferred |
|---|---|---|
| `Meta/ExpressionEngine.cs` caps (`GetObject*Property`, `GetObjectSkillBuffed`, `GetObjectAttribute…`, `GetVitae`, `GetWorldName`, …) | **101** | VTank meta-script layer; the four loops call managers directly, not through the expression engine. |
| `Nav3D*`, `WorldToScreen`, `GetViewportSize`, `GetRadarRect` | ~12 | Render/overlay only (`NavMarkerRenderer`, `RadarWallRenderer`, radar UIs) — irrelevant in `?nullRender=1` bot mode. |
| `SalvageManager` (`HasSalvagePanel`) | 4 | Fully self-gates off: `if(!HasSalvagePanel || !HasUseObject) return;` (`SalvageManager.cs:130`). |
| `MissileCraftingManager`, `PetManager`, `ManaStoneManager`, `Jumper`, `DoorInteractionController` | ~17 | Independent optional subsystems; each `Has*`-gates itself cleanly. |
| `ReadPlayerEnchantments`, `GetServerTime`, `ReadKnownSpells`, `IsSpellKnown`, `GetTargetVitals`, `QueryHealth` | ~12 | All verified graceful — event feeds / static tables substitute. |

**Cumulative:** 8 (spine) → +6 melee → +4 buff → +5 move → +6 loot = **29 host surfaces (17 poll caps, 8 actions, plus 8 event feeds; with reuse the distinct new items per tier are 8/6/4/5/6)** deliver all four loops. That is **~28% of the 104-cap surface** and sidesteps the 101-site ExpressionEngine entirely — confirming the brief's thesis that a partially-implemented host runs the 51.5k-line brain (the plugin already tolerates it via its 367 guards + the self-no-op host actions).

## Holtburger-web mapping notes (host-contract → browser primitives)

Design-level, verified against the plugin's needs (not the web source, which is out of this task's read scope — see MISSING):

- **The tick (cap #1) is the crux.** `OnTick` must be synthesized from the browser's async drain. `?nullRender=1` (pure-protocol mode: sim+net drain, render skipped) + `?netDrainHz=N` is the intended substrate; the host shim would call `plugin.OnTick()` on each drain, translating the poll-vs-async inversion the brief flags as the deepest risk.
- **World model** maps `entityMap` → `OnCreateObject/OnDeleteObject`; per-object `GetObjectPosition/Name/Wcid` become `SessionHandle`/`window.__diag`/`entityMap` field reads. The plugin's landblock-cell packing (`WorldObjectCache.cs:898`) must be reproduced from web coords.
- **Actions** (`MeleeAttack`, `CastSpell`, `UseObject`, `MoveItemExternal`, `SetAutoRun`, `TurnToHeading`) map to `SessionHandle` methods that emit protocol messages via `holtburger-wsbridge`; the crude `k1_drive_combat.cjs` already proves attack/teleport/combat-toggle over CDP, so the message paths exist.
- **Native-attack path is unneeded on web** — prefer direct `MeleeAttack` (`:2839`) since there is no client-side auto-face to defer to.
